title: Steward
description:
DESCRIÇÃO
O Grupo Arpoador busca Steward para nos ajudar a manter nosso ambiente da cozinha limpo e organizado, para que possamos continuar entregando um serviço de excelência para nossos clientes.

Valorizamos os princípios da ética, elegância natural, sustentabilidade, excelência, gentileza e união em todos os aspectos do nosso negócio.

Se você compartilha desses valores e trabalha bem com limpeza, candidate-se

Analisaremos o seu currículo com prazer.

Requisitos

  • Experiência em funções de limpeza.

Responsabilidades
REQUISITOS

  • Apresentar-se ao trabalho nos horários acordados pelo seu superior, sem atrasos ou antecipações.
  • Informar brevemente qualquer problema relacionado a saúde e suposta ausência ao trabalho.
  • Verificar se os equipamentos usados para lavagem de copos, pratos, e talheres foram desligados e ligados corretamente
  • Preparar os produtos de limpeza que serão utilizados,
  • Fazer a limpeza e higiene dos banheiros dos clientes, na loja,
  • Fazer a limpeza interna de toda a loja, antes de sua abertura,
  • Seguir escala de limpeza específica de partes da loja,
  • Seguir qualquer determinação do gerente, mesmo que esta altere a escala de serviço, antes da abertura da loja,
  • Fazer a limpeza e higiene dos banheiros dos funcionários,
  • Limpar toda a parte externa da loja,
  • Limpar a escada de acesso ao piso superior,
  • Verificar necessidade e proceder à limpeza, se necessário, dos banheiros dos clientes a cada duas horas,
  • Limpar todas as áreas de estocagem sob supervisão de responsável,
  • Atender a qualquer momento aos chamados para realizar limpezas da loja ou bar ou cozinha por ocorrências imprevistas,
  • Manter a área de apoio para limpeza, limpa e organizada,
  • Verificar se os sacos de lixos estão íntegros para não causarem sujeira no local de armazenagem,
  • Manter o lixo armazenado durante o dia, de forma organizada,
  • Encaminhar o lixo para fora da loja em local apropriado para coleta, no fechamento de fechamento,
  • Executar todas as atividades para as quais estiver escalado pelo gerente,
  • Conhecer e aplicar todas as regras de limpeza, higiene e conservação dos bens da empresa,
  • Realizar funções novas ou que não sejam de seu costume, caso o gerente assim determine, após instruções,
  • Solicitar informação ou esclarecimento ao superior presente, diante de alguma situação ou ordem para a qual não esteja preparado, tenha dúvida ou desconheça, antes de realizá-la.

title: Coordenador de Planejamento e Controle
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Aegea
Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária
A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom
O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.
Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.
Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Coordenar o planejamento e o controle operacional, garantindo alinhamento entre as metas de eficiência e o orçamento da companhia;
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs), elaborando diagnósticos e planos de ação que impulsionem resultados;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos e propor soluções que otimizem custos e aumentem a produtividade;
  • Integrar informações das áreas operacionais, financeiras e de engenharia, assegurando coerência entre planejamento e execução;
  • Apoiar a liderança nas tomadas de decisão por meio de análises técnicas e financeiras;
  • Estruturar relatórios e apresentações gerenciais, traduzindo dados complexos em informações estratégicas;
  • Atuar próximo às superintendências, fortalecendo a cultura de performance e eficiência.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em planejamento e controle voltado para eficiência operacional, preferencialmente em empresas de grande porte, com unidades descentralizada;
  • Vivência prévia com gestão de pessoas e processos;
  • Conhecimento em análise de custos, orçamento e indicadores de desempenho;
  • Perfil analítico, firme e orientado a resultados, com excelente comunicação e capacidade de articulação entre áreas.

Informações adicionais

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Zenklub - atendimento direcionado à saúde mental;
  • AE Orienta - Aconselhamento Psicológico, Financeiro, Jurídico e social;
  • Gympass - Acesso a academias e demais atividades de bem-estar;
  • Auxilio creche para as mães;
  • Empréstimo consignado em folha;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados.

Rio


Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Technical Project Coordinator

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

With operations in over 120 countries, we provide better solutions for our customers and richer opportunities for our people. As a leading partner to the energy industry, we're committed to achieving net-zero carbon emissions by 2050 and we're always looking for the right people to help us get there. Join Us

A Yduqs é grupo de serviços em educação e tecnologia e temos o objetivo de promover um salto de qualidade para o ensino superior no Brasil. Oferecemos educação de qualidade para pessoas de todas as classes sociais, em todo o país, e ao longo de toda a sua vida adulta.

Educar para transformar.

Transformar a educação no Brasil a partir do uso intenso de tecnologia para apoiar o desenvolvimento de jovens e adultos de todas as classes, do Oiapoque ao Chuí, com práticas sustentáveis para todos os nossos públicos.

A partir do que há de melhor em cada uma de nossas instituições, estamos criando, como nenhuma outra organização conseguiu, um ensino que combina qualidade, escala, amplo acesso, especialização e a integração entre o presencial e o digital.

Contamos com profissionais que valorizam a inovação em um ambiente diverso, com simplicidade e ética. Nossas iniciativas sempre têm o aluno no centro da decisão, pois consideramos o seu sucesso como nosso.

Com uma forte apropriação da cultura digital, atuamos por meio do desenvolvimento de metodologias e de conteúdos que refletem os desafios e as necessidades do nosso tempo.

title: Enterprise Project Manager
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an Enterprise Project Manager

Canonical's mission is to streamline and accelerate the adoption of open source across the entire global enterprise technology market. Our customers embrace the Canonical approach to open source for complex projects on bare metal, on the cloud, and at the edge. Canonical Enterprise Project Managers are responsible for ensuring project success through owning, driving, communicating and respectfully engaging all stakeholders, valuing integrity and accountability.

Within a portfolio of projects with complex and changing software technologies, customer and partner satisfaction is only possible because of exceptional Project Managers who know how to respect and engage all stakeholders.

Location: This is a Globally remote role.

The role entails

  • Ensuring programs and projects are delivered within the schedule, scope, cost, budget and resources expectations
  • Identifying key technical and project risks and issues and actively put mitigating actions in place 
  • Maintaining strong customer focus and working with all key stakeholders to achieve successful outcomes
  • Conducting regular status meetings and business reviews with customers and providing direction when needed
  • Managing the delivery schedule of critical third party deliverables for the project
  • Advocating to customers the appropriate technologies from Canonical's portfolio 
  • Driving project success while managing risks 

What we are looking for in you

  • Experience in Enterprise IT Programs, Process Improvement, and Software Engineering Project Management
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Experience leading cross-cultural, remote and global project teams and customers.
  • Strong negotiation and influencing skills 
  • Strong communication skills
  • Deep understanding of Linux, Open Source, and Cloud Technologies 
  • Bachelor's Degree in a STEM discipline
  • Project Management Certification, preferably PMP or equivalent certification
  • Agile Project Management certification, preferably Scrum Master or equivalent certification
  • Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally

What we offer colleagues


We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical


Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Condition Based Monitoring Lead
description:
Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition. Now, see how a role change can develop you, and us, even more.


About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production in offshore oil and gas. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise. It means continuing to enable decarbonization and support the energy transition, while diversifying our unique capabilities to help more blue economy industries grow and thrive sustainably. Through our strategy of Advancing Our Core and Pioneering More and our values of Care, Integrity, Collaboration, and Ownership, we are sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Purpose

  • As Condition Based Monitoring Lead, you are responsible for leading the CBM team driving an effective and efficient execution and management of the global CBM program compliant with internal and external (e.g. classificiations bodies) requirements; supporting the operating regions and assets in realizing an optimal performance of the rotating. equipment on the offshore assets.

Responsibilities

  • You are responsible for leading the global CBM team.
  • You are responsible for the effective and efficient execution and management of the global CBM program.
  • You work closely with other departments to ensure optimal performance of rotating equipment on SBM FPSOs by supporting operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, failure investigation and continuous improvement activities.
  • You are responsible for compliance with internal and external requirements with e.g. the Preventive Maintenance Program requirements from the relevant classification bodies.
  • You are responsible for CBM governance processes, tools and strategies to drive performance.
  • You stay updated on the latest advancements in CBM technologies and best practices in the industry.
  • You manage the Vibration & Oil Analysis Database and other CBM tools and software.
  • You drive the CBM work process automation program (use of data analytics/AI)

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field is required. Minimum ISO Cat III certification; Offshore survival and medical desirable/required.

Experience

  • Experience in the Oil & Gas industry.
  • Advanced knowledge in the field of Machinery Condition monitoring. 
  • Good knowledge of Bently Nevada System 1 or ADRE; Rotor dynamic knowledge. 
  • Knowledge of Omnitrend is a plus.
  • Strong knowledge of rotating machinery, including compressors, turbines, and pumps.
  • Proficiency in using diagnostic tools and software for equipment analysis.
  • Knowledge of predictive maintenance technologies and practices.
  • Proven ability to lead and motivate a team.
  • Effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivated, enthusiastic.

Functional Competencies


Mechanical Rotating Equipment - Vibration Analysis Mechanical Rotating Equipment - Tribology Integrity and Reliability - Remote Surveillance and Monitoring Integrity and Reliability - Predictive maintenance Mechanical Rotating Equipment - Gas Compressor Mechanical Rotating Equipment - Gas Turbine Mechanical Rotating Equipment - Pumps Troubleshooting Reliability, operability and safety Learning from events

  • Incorporar os princípios da metodologia 5S ao ambiente e às práticas de trabalho diárias.

Qualificações

  • Cursando Ensino Técnico em Eletrotécnica – preferencialmente com 02 anos para se formar;
    ou
  • Cursando Ensino Superior em Engenharia Elétrica – preferencialmente estando no início do curso da graduação, com disponibilidade para estagiar por 02 anos;
  • Perfil analítico, com bom raciocínio lógico e numérico;
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita;
  • Domínio do Pacote Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint e Outlook);
  • Ter boa organização pessoal;
  • Conhecimento em inglês nível básico/intermediário (desejável);
  • Proatividade na proposição de novos KPIs e ações;
  • Habilidade e conhecimento em AutoCAD seria um diferencial;
  • Habilidade e conhecimento em Power BI seria um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de vendas e negociação seria um diferencial;

  • Gostar de ambientes de trabalho dinâmicos;

Local de Trabalho: Del Castilho, Rio de Janeiro/RJ.

A combinar, podendo ser:

  • Das 08:00h às 13:00h, de segunda à sexta-feira;
    ou

  1. Envie seu currículo atualizado para o e-mail , especificando no assunto o nome da vaga: "Estagiário Comercial";
  2. Após a etapa de análise dos currículos, a nossa área de Recursos Humanos, entrará em contato para agendar sua primeira entrevista, para a análise do perfil comportamental do candidato;
  3. Após a primeira fase de entrevista, e sendo aprovado o perfil indicado pelo RH, será agendada uma entrevista final com o Gestor da área.

Sobre nós

A BRVAL tornou-se referência nacional no fornecimento de equipamentos elétricos para grandes projetos de engenharia nas últimas duas décadas.

Com unidades fabris localizadas em Valença/RJ e Sorocaba/SP, uma área industrial de mais de m², somos fabricantes de subestações de energia blindadas, painés elétricos de média e baixa tensão, transformadores de média tensão e diversos outros equipamentos eletromecânicos.

title: Integration Engineer
description:

Job Description:

What's the role

The Integration Engineer will provide technical support to liaise with the FPSO Coordinator, Subsea Coordinator, and internal Shell teams, supporting the Asset Integration Lead on End-to-End activities. This role adds technical support to ensure alignment with business priorities, supply chain, contract management and commercial use of MTO, WRFM and external areas, interacting with Shell technical teams to maximize asset value and strengthen Shell's commercial position. Amongst those initiatives are the OP cycle and JV engagements. This position is a development opportunity for technical staff aiming to develop business and commercial skillsets or advance into managerial roles. The Integration Engineer will act as a deputy for the BC10 Asset Integration Lead whenever required

What you'll be doing

Technical Support and Integration:

  • Liaise with FPSO and Subsea Coordinators to support technically E2E business planning, operational plans, and strategic reviews.
  • Provide quality assurance over production planning, WRFM activities, contractor production targets, forecasts, and reports for partners and external stakeholders, ensuring integration with the allocation and IAPs process.
  • Act with situational leadership on end-to-end matters of the asset, guaranteeing alignment amongst the areas involved, providing support to technical teams on work prioritization.
  • Support the development and execution of business and operational plans, OP, production targets.
  • Support offloading schedules, and 90 days forecast plan.

Continuous Improvement:

  • Drive asset value improvements, GHG programs, and commercial excellence in line with Shell standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Support the development and execution of business and operational improvement plans.
  • Lead asset integration projects to enhance performance and cost reduction.

Business & Contract Management:

  • Develop and maintain relationships with third-party contractors, acting as a technical sponsor.
  • Ensure operational decisions align with Shell priorities and integration with multiple internal and external departments, protecting value for Shell.

Collaboration and Communication:

  • Work collaboratively with offshore and office teams to align operational decisions with the asset´s priorities and goals, supporting strategic decisions.
  • Act as an integrator to drive value for Shell by analyzing activities and providing technical support for prioritizing activities and interventions throughout the IAPs process.

Risk Management:

  • Manage the asset risk register and support the CA assurance activities planning and recommendation execution.
  • Support partner and stakeholder engagement, including claims and dispute management.

Regulatory Compliance:

  • Ensure compliance with Shell E&P HSE Minimum Standards and Global Processes.
  • Act as a change agent for operational excellence and operating integrity programs in line with local regulatory requirements and industry standards.

What you bring

  • Must have legal authorization to work full-time for any employer other than the current one.
  • Engineering degree (Production; Mechanical; Chemical etc.)
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in technical or operations-based roles within the Exploration & Production (E&P) industry.
  • Proven ability to identify and manage risks in complex, simultaneous operations.
  • Experience in deep-water technical or operational roles is highly desirable.
  • Strong understanding of operational capabilities and assurance processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across organizational boundaries and with external partners.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong leadership and accountability.
  • Excellent interpersonal and team collaboration skills.
  • Proficiency in conflict resolution and problem-solving.
  • Self-motivated and proactive team player.
  • Commitment to Health, Safety, Security, and Environment (HSSE) standards and alignment with Shell's core values.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while aligning with organizational goals.
  • Experience in coaching, mentoring, and working with diverse teams.
  • Strong awareness of and advocacy for diversity and inclusion.

What we offer

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You'll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You'll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.

  • Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
  • Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
  • Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
  • Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
  • Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
  • Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.
  • Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.
  • Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non-birthing parents.
  • Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
  • Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams.
  • Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

We'd like you to know that Shell has a bold goal: to become one of the world's most diverse and inclusive companies. You can get to know more about how we're working towards that goal, .

Shell in Brazil

Who We Are

Shell is a global group of energy and petrochemical companies, employing 103,000 people and with operations in more than 70 countries. We use advanced technologies and take an innovative approach as we seek to help the world build a sustainable energy future.

Shell is a customer-focused organisation, serving more than 1 million commercial and industrial customers, and around 33 million customers daily at more than 47,000 Shell-branded retail service stations.

Our approach

Powering Progress sets our strategy to become a net-zero emissions energy business by 2050, generating value for our shareholders, our customers and wider society. As we move forward on this journey, we will power lives and respect nature while maintaining our core values of honesty, integrity, and respect for people.

Our values

At Shell, we share a set of core values – honesty, integrity and respect for people – which underpin all the work we do. title: Mechanical Technician Lead
description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact.  Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.
About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably.  Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Reports To


  • Mechanical Supervisor

    • Background


  • The Technician Lead must show strong safety behavior acting as a safety culture disseminator.
  • They will ensure all procedures will always be followed and that O &M Contractor and local regulatory compliance are met in all aspects of work.
  • The Technician Lead is responsible for executing maintenance and preservation tasks efficiently and safely to ensure the reliability and longevity of equipment. This role involves performing a variety of maintenance and preservation activities, including but not limited to cleaning, housekeeping, blasting, spraying/painting, isolation and reinstatement, greasing application, and the preservation of topside items like flanges, bolts and valves.
  • The technician is also responsible for ensuring that his supervisor is made aware of all activities according to procedure, especially when safety is an issue.
  • The technician lead will demonstrate exemplary safety awareness and technical competence in all aspects of maintenance and preservation work on and around the vessel
  • They act as a technical leader to all technicians using their seniority, technical experience and knowledge.
  • They can delegate work and responsibilities to the technicians they lead during the execution of their routines.
  • They act as Technician when required by workload and/or requested by the Supervisor.

    • Authority


  • A Mechanical Technician Led is authorized to maintain and repair vessel mechanical equipment and systems.

    • Immediate Subordinates


  • Mechanical Technicians, Subcontractors, Visitors and Vendor Representatives

    • Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards


  • 1) Dismantle Repair and Reassemble Mechanical Equipment.
  • 1 Identify potential sources of hazard prior to dismantling.
  • 2 Use correct procedures and correct method of dismantling.
  • 3 Carry out the correct isolation and disconnection procedure.
  • 4 Identified, checked and prepared components.
  • 5 Apply appropriate tests and test equipment to ensure reassembly is correct and effective.
  • 2) Use of Condition Monitoring on Mechanical Equipment.
  • 1 Adjust instruments to meet the operating specification.
  • 2 Adjust with minimum disruption to any ongoing activities and minimum waste of resources.
  • 3 Monitor and record what has been carried out in work history or log.
  • 3) Diagnose faults in Mechanical Equipment.
  • 1 Respond promptly to problems in line with approved procedures.
  • 2 Select appropriate tests and diagnostic procedures and apply them methodically.
  • 3 Carry out Visual, Close and Detailed inspections on Mechanical equipment.
  • 4 Use the results of inspections to determine the appropriate actions to take.
  • 5 Record an accurate and full description in the appropriate document history.
  • 4) Monitor and Maintain Pollution Control Measures.
  • 1 Unplanned discharges to the environment are identified, halted where possible, and reported according to policy, procedure and regulation.
  • 2
  • Relevant PPE is used to deal with unplanned discharges using company procedures.
  • 3
  • Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are dealt with according to the correct procedure.
  • 4
  • Environmental protection and pollution control are enforced effectively with colleagues, subordinates and subcontractors.
  • 5) Contribute to The Health and Safety of the Working Environment
  • 1
  • Work area within your own responsibility is kept clean and free of hazards.
  • 2
  • Positive action is taken to stop hazards and unsafe behaviors.
  • 3
  • Alarms are raised as appropriate and/or acted upon using applied policies and procedures or initiative.
  • 4
  • Colleagues and subcontractors are alerted ASAP of any hazards or potentially dangerous changing conditions.
  • 5
  • All potential and actual incidents are reported to the relevant supervisor.
  • 6) Emergency Response
  • 1 Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).
  • 2 Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises.

    • Recruitment Only-Generic Functional Competencies


    Offshore - Demonstrate an Understanding of PandIds Offshore - Routine Servicing of Systems and Equipment Offshore - Rectifying Faults in Systems and Equipment Offshore - Handover Offshore - Emergency Response Offshore - Diagnosis and Fault Finding Offshore - Planning Work Offshore - Dismantling, Repair and Reassemble Equipment Offshore - Safety Management

    Pre-hire Qualifications and Experience


  • Proven experience and/or qualified to N/SVQ/HNC/HND in Mechanical Engineering or local equivalent.
  • Experience desired with offshore experience preferred.
  • Experience and knowledge of hydrocarbon processing systems and utilities.
  • Good experience of Permit to Work, Mechanical Isolation Standards and Risk Assessment.
  • Proficiency in English at a minimum of B2 level according to the CEFR international standard.
  • Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.

    • GENERAL INFORMATION

    SBM Offshore N.V. is a listed holding company that is headquartered in Amsterdam. It holds direct and indirect interests in other companies that collectively with SBM Offshore N.V. form the SBM Offshore Group ("the Company"). For further information, please visit our website at The companies in which SBM Offshore N.V., directly and indirectly, owns investments are separate entities.

    SBM Offshore is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. SBM Offshore does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.  All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

title: Golang Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems for global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring Golang engineers of all levels of seniority, for all relevant teams at Canonical. Apply here if you are an exceptional software engineer who prefers to work in Go. After the first round of interviews we'll find the best fit product team at Canonical for you to progress your application based on your personal interests.

Canonical prefers Golang for software where performance and security are primary considerations. We also have substantial projects in Python, C, C++ and are starting to invest in Rust. For front-end development we prefer React and Flutter.

Golang is an essential language for our engineering teams, who build the systems that deliver Ubuntu to the world. From our software distribution systems, to those which build and test every possible kind of open source on every architecture, from our systems management tools to our distributed systems operations R&D, we count on Golang for its tasteful concurrency and developer ecosystem. Juju, Livepatch, LXD, MAAS, Microk8s, Snapd, Ubuntu Core, Ubuntu Pro, and many more Canonical offerings include Golang components.

We also want to ensure that Ubuntu is the very best platform for Golang development, offering easy access to the widest range of tooling and capabilities that support cutting edge open source and enterprise development.

Join us in our mission to deliver innovative open-source solutions to individuals and enterprises around the world. We expect the highest engineering standards and strong motivation to get things done well in a fully remote and distributed environment. These roles require extensive personal experience with Linux - the more different versions of Linux the better

Location: we have open roles for Golang engineers in every time zone

The role entails

  • Design and implement well-tested and documented software in Go
  • Debug and fix issues encountered by your users
  • Participate in our engineering process through code and architectural reviews
  • Collaborate with community and colleagues on technical specifications
  • Seek improvements to engineering and operations practices
  • In some cases, deploy and operate services developed by the team
  • Contribute to the success of your product through technical advocacy

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Well-organized, self-starting and able to deliver to schedule
  • Professional manner interacting with colleagues, partners, and community
  • Experience designing and writing high-quality Golang software on Linux
  • Experience with and passion for Linux at the system level
  • For more senior roles, experience building, deploying, and operating distributed systems and APIs
  • Professional written and spoken English 
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred) 
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability 
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation 
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills 
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments 
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Nice-to-have skills

  • Experience developing for Ubuntu Linux
  • Experience with Juju, LXD, Microk8s, Snapd, Ubuntu Core, Ubuntu Pro
  • Performance engineering and security experience

What we offer colleagues


We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical


Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Developer Relations Engineer
description:
As the publisher of Ubuntu we serve millions of developers, building for the cloud, IoT and data science. We aim to make open source easier and more reliable for innovators and enterprises.

We have created a new Developer Relations team to engage directly with open source communities and developer-centric organisations. We hope both to communicate our vision and products for better open source development experiences, and also to have a better feedback loop from those audiences to shape our offerings and priorities.

A Developer Relations Engineer is a technical expert, strategist and communicator with deep empathy for developers. This discipline combines practical engineering skills with firm diplomacy across organisational boundaries, in both directions. Like our audience, a Developer Relations Engineer is never satisfied with the status quo, and is driven by an insatiable curiosity to find better ways to get things done. They are problem-solvers and inventors, who understand people's needs and love the way that tools can be adapted to meet them. They stay current with tech trends and provide insights and guidance while fostering innovation.

To improve your chances of success in this application, read our advice on how to get a job at Canonical.

Location: we are building our initial DevRel team in Europe, Middle East, African and American time zones

What your day will look like


In a typical day, a developer relations engineer might:

  • take part in team product meetings, at levels from strategy to day-by-day development progress, contributing insight and expertise
  • maintain conversations with developer community members wherever they may be found - IRC, social media, product forums, meet-ups and more
  • work with colleagues in other teams in the company, as part of efforts to help establish commonality and consistent approaches 
  • help solve specific technical problems that users or colleagues have identified 
  • contribute to technical documentation to ensure that developer users' needs are met there
  • work on technical articles, presentations or workshops 
  • identify new opportunities and directions for improvement in the developer experience we provide
  • present at conferences, meetups or technical events

What we are looking for in you


A strong candidate

  • is a programmer or developer with a demonstrable passion for and engagement in open-source software
  • has worked with real-world challenges developing and deploying software using Linux
  • has practical hands-on experience of Linux software packaging (including Snaps, debs, charms, rocks, PIP, containers)
  • understands current software packing issues and trends in the Linux ecosystem 
  • has been a contributor to open-source communities, software and documentation
  • is an engaging, vivacious speaker and presenter
  • can work effectively, tactfully, empathetically and confidently in contexts where different parties have different perspectives, needs and understanding
  • builds trust, relationships and confidence
  • is willing to travel globally twice a year for company events, as well as to upstream and partner events

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • previous experience in a developer advocacy or community role
  • in-depth familiarity with Ubuntu and the Canonical ecosystem of products

What we offer you


We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical


Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer


We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Analista Devops Sênior
description:
Descrição da vaga

Nós movemos o mercado financeiro para o futuro, impulsionando negócios e potencializar a economia do país. Com o maior hub de dados e informações do cenário financeiro brasileiro, lideramos iniciativas que realmente importam: defendemos os interesses dos nossos parceiros e investidores, fornecemos ferramentas analíticas e dados, educamos investidores e certificamos profissionais, além de estabelecermos regras para as instituições do mercado financeiro e de capitais.

Buscamos um
Analista Devops Sênior
garantir agilidade e eficiência no atendimento às demandas do time de desenvolvimento, atuando na construção de novas iniciativas e aplicações com integração direta às áreas de negócio. Buscando soluções inovadoras que permitam desenvolver melhor, em menos tempo e com maior qualidade, além de definir arquiteturas e interfaces que assegurem reuso e otimização de recursos. que será responsável por habilitar times de desenvolvimento no uso eficiente e seguro do ecossistema de entrega contínua e testes automatizados (CI) de aplicações Java/Spring Boot.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas de desenvolvimento, operação e suporte;
  • Ajudar na automatização de tarefas;
  • Apoiar na administração e controle do ambiente Devops (Jenkins/Git/Sonar/Scripts e etc.) junto aos desenvolvedores, suporte à aplicação e Arquitetos de sistemas;
  • Criar e manter pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Trabalhar e promover a utilização de containers e Kubernetes/Openshift;
  • Responsável por auxiliar no planejamento e execução de tarefas de projetos diversos do desenvolvimento de sistemas e testes integrados (CI);
  • Acompanhar, participar e executar as atividades relativas à manutenção evolutiva dos sistemas;
  • Atuar proativamente junto aos times de desenvolvimento e performance, que envolvem provisionamento de recursos, monitoramento, troubleshooting, segurança (DevSecOPs) e evolução de tecnologias relativas a sua área.

Requisitos e qualificações

Somos uma organização social privada sem fins lucrativos, especializada em gerir centros culturais públicos de grande importância para o país e programas ambientais. Atualmente, também prestamos consultorias para a concepção, modelagem, formatação e gestão de projetos, desenvolvendo o escopo, fazendo a captação de recursos, o enquadramento nas leis de incentivo e gerindo sua implementação.

Nossos projetos ativos:

O Paço do Frevo, localizado no coração do Recife, é mais do que um museu; é um guardião do patrimônio mundial da humanidade, celebrando a riqueza e a diversidade de nossa cultura.

O Museu do Amanhã, uma fascinante instituição de ciências no Rio de Janeiro, convida você a refletir sobre nossas ações presentes e seu impacto no amanhã, inspirando mudanças para um futuro melhor.

O Museu das Favelas em São Paulo é um espaço de resiliência e criatividade das comunidades, revelando a potência e o brilho das favelas através de suas histórias e expressões culturais únicas.

O Museu do Jardim Botânico do Rio de Janeiro é uma viagem encantadora pelo mundo da botânica, convidando você a explorar a beleza e a importância das plantas em nossas vidas.

O Programa de Formação Cultural CULTSP PRO - Escolas de Profissionais e de Empreendedores da Cultura, no Estado de São Paulo, oferece cursos em diversas áreas, incluindo Artes Cênicas, Audiovisual, Games, Moda, entre outras.

Sediado na cidade de Belém, o novo Museu das Amazônias, implementado pelo IDG em parceria com o Museu Paraense Emílio Goeldi, será uma referência na área de ciências e tecnologias. Com experiências imersivas e coletivas, irá reunir as muitas Amazônias, nacionais e internacionais, e aproximar os vários setores sociais para debater os temas da área.

Além dos museus, temos também a gestão do Fundo da Mata Atlântica e atuamos na revitalização do Cais do Valongo-RJ.

Nosso propósito é: Esperançar futuros possíveis


Nossos Valores:

  • Criativos na essência: Acreditamos que a criatividade está no nosso DNA. Todos podemos praticá-la no dia a dia, seja na tarefa mais simples ou em projetos complexos;
  • Autenticamente diversos: Somos muitos, somos diferentes e cada vivência e visão de mundo importa. É da soma dessas diferenças que vêm as nossas melhores ideias;
  • Compromisso com excelência: Fazemos sempre o nosso melhor. Nos orgulhamos de estabelecer boas relações com nossos parceiros, colaboradores e todas as pessoas que estão na nossa rede, e de criar espaços encantadores de reflexão e conhecimento.
  • Respeito aos acordos: Entendemos que o respeito vai além da boa educação e deve ser a base no tratamento com qualquer um. Respeitamos os acordos e oferecemos segurança jurídica e financeira para construir laços de confiança.
  • Encantamento: Recebemos as pessoas com prazer e nos orgulhamos quando elas são maravilhadas pelos nossos espaços, seja no ambiente corporativo, seja nos museus. Incentivamos as pessoas a alcançarem o seu potencial e vivemos entusiasmados pelo nosso propósito.

Se você compartilha da nossa paixão por promover o acesso à cultura, preservar o meio ambiente e inspirar mudanças positivas, junte-se a nós Estamos sempre em busca de mentes criativas e comprometidas para se juntar à nossa equipe e fazer a diferença.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Who Are We?

Decentralized Masters stands at the forefront of DeFi education globally. We are the #1 Decentralized Finance Education Company. In just two years, our ambitious team expanded from a pioneering pair of co-founders to over 75 dedicated professionals. Today, we are recognized as one of the fastest-growing enterprises in the sector, with industry insiders predicting our evolution into a unicorn company by 2030. Operating on a bootstrapped model, we are on track to achieve an impressive $50 million in revenue this year alone.
A Non-Custodial Wallet Designed for Everyday Users

Our wallet is built with a core focus on asset protection, ensuring that users' crypto remains safe and accessible, even in the event of unforeseen circumstances.

Tailored specifically for retail users who are new to the crypto space, especially those transitioning from centralized exchanges, our wallet offers a seamless, intuitive experience that feels as familiar as online banking.

What truly sets us apart is our unparalleled access to the largest distribution of crypto newcomers. This gives us a unique advantage: any product we build is instantly positioned in front of a high-intent audience ready to adopt it.

Our Vision

Our goal is clear: to create the biggest and most influential DeFi ecosystem the world has ever seen - starting with becoming the gold standard in DeFi education, which we're already doing with our brand, Decentralized Masters. Now, we are embarking on an exciting new venture to build a comprehensive crypto estate planning and non-custodial wallet. 

We are launching this new product after witnessing substantial success in the DeFi education space and identifying a significant demand directly from our customers. Our unfair advantage over any competition is our distribution: we own a growing army of loyal customers eager to purchase our new solutions.

Are You Ready?

This is more than a job; it's a call to those who are in it for the long term. This crypto estate planning and non-custodial wallet will completely redefine what's possible in DeFi and beyond. Your full commitment will be needed. If you're ready to change the world of Decentralized Finance alongside some of the brightest minds in the space - this is for you.
What Will You Be Doing?

As a Full Stack Developer, you'll be responsible for developing end-to-end features with a strong focus on frontend infrastructure while maintaining excellent back-end quality. You'll work closely with design, product, and marketing teams to ensure an intuitive and scalable product launch.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architecture & Development:
    • Develop robust APIs, server-side logic, and database schemas.
    • Implement secure systems for authentication, encryption, and potentially private key management.
  • Frontend Integration: (most important
    • Contribute to the development of sleek, responsive UIs using React and integrate backend services into the frontend stack.
    • Build reusable components and ensure pixel-perfect implementation from design mockups.
  • Web3 Implementation:
    • Integrate blockchain functionality using libraries like , Viem, Wagmi.
    • Support smart account and wallet functionality, including gasless transactions and smart contract interaction.
  • DevOps & Testing:
    • Write unit/integration tests and optimize app performance.
    • Collaborate on CI/CD pipelines and deploy across cloud platforms.
  • Collaboration & Strategy:
    • Partner closely with other teams to align features with business needs.
    • Provide input into technical architecture and roadmap planning.

Requirements

What Will You Bring?

Experience

  • 3–5+ years in a React-heavy role with full stack experience
  • Proven experience building React apps following best practices
  • Experience with front-end technologies (React, Tailwind/Figma handoff).
  • Exposure to or interest in Web3, wallets, passkeys, account abstraction technology and smart contract integration.
  • Bonus: Experience with PostgreSQL, or cloud platforms (AWS, etc.).

Education

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field preferred — but real-world experience and a portfolio will speak louder.

Skills

  • Back-End: , Express, PostgreSQL, REST, APIs.
  • Front-End: React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Figma (for UI/UX handoff).
  • Web3 (Nice to Have): , Dynamic SDK, ZeroDev SDK, Viem.
  • Tools & Systems: Git, CI/CD, AWS.
  • Soft Skills: Proactive mindset, clear communicator, ownership mentality, eagerness to build something world-class from scratch.

Benefits

What Do We Offer You?

  • Competitive salary package
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Fully remote team — work from anywhere in the world
  • Team off-sites and retreats (we're big on connection)
  • High-impact role in a fast-growing company poised for unicorn status
  • Culture of autonomy, innovation, and growth

Ready to Build the Future of DeFi?

Join a mission-driven team that's reshaping how people manage their crypto wealth. If you're passionate about solving meaningful problems, writing clean code, and building industry-defining products - apply now.

title: AI Agent Evaluation Analyst
description:
This opportunity is only for candidates currently residing in the specified country. Your location may affect eligibility and rates. Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective human intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI. 

What we do

The Mindrift platform, launched and powered by Toloka, connects domain experts with cutting-edge AI projects from innovative tech clients. Our mission is to unlock the potential of GenAI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

Who we're looking for:

We're looking for curious and intellectually proactive contributors, the kind of person who double-checks assumptions and plays devil's advocate. 

Are you comfortable with ambiguity and complexity? Does an async, remote, flexible opportunity sound exciting? Would you like to learn how modern AI systems are tested and evaluated?

This is a flexible, project-based opportunity well-suited for:

  • Analysts, researchers, or consultants with strong critical thinking skills.
  • Students (senior undergrads / grad students) looking for an intellectually interesting gig.
  • People open to a part-time and non-permanent opportunity.


About the project:

We're on the hunt for QAs for autonomous AI agents for a new project focused on validating and improving complex task structures, policy logic, and agent evaluation frameworks. Throughout the project, you'll have to balance quality assurance, research, and logical problem-solving. This project opportunity is ideal for people who enjoy looking at systems holistically and thinking through scenarios, implications, and edge cases.

You do not need a coding background, but you must be curious, intellectually rigorous, and capable of evaluating the soundness and consistency of complex setups. If you've ever excelled in things like consulting, CHGK, Olympiads, case solving, or systems thinking — you might be a great fit.

What you'll be doing:

  • Reviewing evaluation tasks and scenarios for logic, completeness, and realism.
  • Identifying inconsistencies, missing assumptions, or unclear decision points.
  • Helping define clear expected behaviors (gold standards) for AI agents.
  • Annotating cause-effect relationships, reasoning paths, and plausible alternatives.
  • Thinking through complex systems and policies as a human would to ensure agents are tested properly.
  • Working closely with QA, writers, or developers to suggest refinements or edge case coverage.

How to get started:

Apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to a project aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. Shape the future of AI while building tools that benefit everyone.

Requirements

  • Excellent analytical thinking: Can reason about complex systems, scenarios, and logical implications.
  • Strong attention to detail: Can spot contradictions, ambiguities, and vague requirements.
  • Familiarity with structured data formats: Can read, not necessarily write JSON/YAML.
  • Ability to assess scenarios holistically: What's missing, what's unrealistic, what might break?
  • Good communication and clear writing (in English) to document your findings.

We also value applicants who have:

  • Experience with policy evaluation, logic puzzles, case studies, or structured scenario design.
  • Background in consulting, academia, olympiads (e.g. logic/math/informatics), or research.
  • Exposure to LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI-generated content.
  • Familiarity with QA or test-case thinking (edge cases, failure modes, "what could go wrong").
  • Some understanding of how scoring or evaluation works in agent testing (precision, coverage, etc.).

Benefits

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $17/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs.
  • Take part in a flexible, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Participate in an advanced AI project and gain valuable experience to enhance your portfolio.
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Produto
description:
Sobre a BigDataCorp

A BigDataCorp é a maior datatech da América Latina, e democratiza, desde 2013, o acesso aos dados, aumentando possibilidades e certezas em um mundo repleto de incertezas.

Somos pioneiros na captura, estruturação, armazenamento e distribuição de dados no Brasil. Nosso processo é único. Já nascemos adequados à LGPD e às demais regulamentações, garantindo a origem das informações fornecidas, obtidas sempre de forma ética.

Sobre a área e a vaga

A pessoa escolhida irá trabalhar no time de Apps, responsáveis pela manutenção e evolução dos aplicativos disponibilizados pela BigDataCorp no mercado. O foco será no BigID, uma avançada ferramenta de validação de identidade e prevenção à fraude. A atuação será no gerenciamento do desenvolvimento nas subcélulas de Documentoscopia, Biometria, KBA, Device Id e BackgroundCheck. O profissional será responsável por maximizar o valor gerado pelas aplicações, garantindo o alinhamento estratégico do desenvolvimento e a eficiência operacional da equipe em um cenário de crescente automação e complexidade tecnológica.

O que vai fazer no dia a dia

  • Gerir o ciclo de vida das funcionalidades, desde a tradução de requisitos em histórias de usuário até a priorização do backlog com base em um raciocínio estruturado e critérios de impacto, ROI e esforço;
  • Desenvolver e manter o roadmap estratégico das aplicações, identificando e planejando as iniciativas futuras que garantirão a evolução e a competitividade do produto;
  • Liderar a execução tática da equipe no dia a dia, facilitando as cerimônias ágeis, otimizando o fluxo de trabalho no Jira e removendo impedimentos para garantir a previsibilidade das entregas;
  • Atuar como um mentor para a equipe, fomentando uma cultura de autonomia, segurança psicológica e melhoria contínua, e garantindo que o time compreenda o "porquê" estratégico por trás das tarefas que executam;
  • Definir e acompanhar os KPIs e métricas de sucesso para cada entrega, aplicando senso crítico para avaliar o desempenho das funcionalidades no nível operacional e validando hipóteses com testes A/B;
  • Consolidar os resultados e dados de produto para comunicar o valor gerado e o alinhamento com os OKRs da empresa, garantindo o engajamento e a visibilidade junto aos stakeholders e à diretoria;
  • Estabelecer e operar um sistema contínuo de coleta e análise de feedback, dados de uso e entrevistas com clientes para compreender profundamente o desempenho e a usabilidade do produto;
  • Utilizar os insights coletados para realizar análises de mercado, identificar tendências e descobrir novas oportunidades ou dores de clientes não atendidas, informando a estratégia de longo prazo.

Requirements


Habilidades necessárias

  • Experiência em gestão de produtos digitais (ex.: Product Manager, Product Owner etc.), idealmente em ambientes de tecnologia B2B;
  • Elevado senso crítico e raciocínio estruturado para decompor problemas complexos, questionar premissas e validar informações em um ambiente com crescente uso de automação e IA;
  • Experiência em gestão e desenvolvimento de pessoas;
  • Capacidade de aprendizado contínuo, com autonomia para se manter atualizado sobre novas tecnologias, metodologias e tendências de mercado;
  • Inteligência emocional e maturidade para atuar como uma ponte eficaz entre negócio e tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento sobre arquitetura de software (design patterns) e gerenciamento de projetos;
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis e ferramentas de gestão de projetos (ex.: Jira);
  • Perfil analítico e voltado a dados para fundamentar decisões estratégicas e de priorização;
  • Habilidades de comunicação e negociação para interagir com diferentes níveis hierárquicos, de equipes técnicas a executivos, tanto internamente quanto com clientes externos.

O que faz brilhar os nossos olhos

  • Vivência no setor de dados, analytics ou em plataformas SaaS de alta complexidade;
  • Visão estratégica sobre o impacto e a aplicação de Inteligência Artificial no ciclo de desenvolvimento de software e na evolução de produtos digitais;
  • Compreensão de arquiteturas de software modernas e ambientes de nuvem (AWS) para facilitar o diálogo com equipes de engenharia e avaliar a viabilidade técnica de novas funcionalidades.

Benefits


O que oferecemos

title: Contract Manager
description:
Overview

WELCOME TO SITA   

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward—we're proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work by our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

Are you ready to love your job? The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR RESUME IN ENGLISH

ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM

The Contracts Manager will be responsible for the full contract lifecycle, from drafting and negotiation to execution, performance monitoring and renewal or termination in support of business objectives and business growth. Responsible for delivering and implementing the full range of contract activities following contract management best practices policy and process throughout the organisation in support of standard, tailored, or complex bids during pre-sales and post-sales phases.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Prepare, draft, review, and negotiate both SITA and non-SITA contracts (including commercial agreements and NDAs), ensuring compliance with company policies and legal requirements.
  • Support the legal and bid departments in identifying, assessing, and managing contractual risks, including documents that deviate from standard SITA policies and procedures.
  • Oversee the entire contract lifecycle and serve as the main point of contact for all contractual matters, liaising with internal departments (legal, finance, sales, etc.) and external parties to resolve issues and ensure mutual understanding of contract terms.
  • Track key contract milestones, obligations, and deadlines, and manage the process for contract amendments, modifications, and renewals.
  • Support on maintaining contract databases to ensure data is accurate, including the profiling and audit of contracts and handling administrative tasks (signature process, scanning of contracts, archiving, etc.)
  • Prepare and present regular reports to senior management on contract status, performance, and risk assessments.
Qualifications

WHO YOU ARE

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, Business, or related field.
  • Minimum 8 years of professional experience, including at least 5 years in contract management within the Telecommunications or IT sector and proven ability to structure, review, negotiate, and manage complex contracts.
  • Fluent in Portuguese, Spanish and English (spoken and written).
  • Strong understanding of contract law, risk assessment, negotiation, conflict resolution and legal terminology.
  • Legal background is a bonus, but not required.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel), Salesforce reporting tools, and contract lifecycle management (CLM) systems.
  • Detail-oriented, analytical, and highly organized with strong time-management skills.
  • Ability to follow corporate policies and procedures.
  • Experience in Public Procurement is desirable, but not mandatory.

WHAT WE OFFER

SITA's workplace is all about diversity, many different countries and cultures are represented in our workforce. We collaborate in our impressive offices, embracing a hybrid work format. As part of our global benefits, we offer:

 Employee Wellbeing: Benefit from the Employee Assistance Program (EAP) provided by SITA, a yearly free service offering practical advice in various aspects of your life.
 Professional Development: Enhance your skills with our training platforms, inclusive of LinkedIn Learning
 Competitive Benefits: Access competitive benefits tailored to the local market and your employment status.

"Equal Employment Opportunity Employer / Veterans / Disabled.  SITA is an equal employment opportunity employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against based on disability"

title: Condition Based Monitoring Engineer
description:
Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition. Now, see how a role change can develop you, and us, even more.


About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production in offshore oil and gas. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise. It means continuing to enable decarbonization and support the energy transition, while diversifying our unique capabilities to help more blue economy industries grow and thrive sustainably. Through our strategy of Advancing Our Core and Pioneering More and our values of Care, Integrity, Collaboration, and Ownership, we are sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Purpose


  • You support the effective management and optimization of rotating equipment on SBM FPSOs by monitoring and analyzing machinery conditions. Your role is crucial in ensuring equipment reliability and operational efficiency through continuous condition-based monitoring, data analysis, and collaboration with various teams. You play a key role in troubleshooting, maintenance planning, and guiding the technical team in making informed decisions to prevent failures, enhance equipment lifespan, and support safe and efficient operations.

    • Responsibilities


  • You support Machinery Engineers and the Maintenance Team in managing the Condition-Based Program for rotating equipment on SBM FPSOs, including compressors, turbines, blowers, pumps, gearboxes, and motors;
  • You review and monitor rotating equipment conditions using vibration data, lube oil results, and other critical operating data (e.g., pressures, temperatures, flows, loads, efficiencies) to assess equipment health.;
  • Manage the Vibration & Oil Analysis Database and support the issuance of recommendations, consolidating inputs from third parties for the Offshore crew;
  • You are responsible for Input actions in the Computerized Maintenance Management System;
  • You should Follow-up on recommendations execution and effectiveness;
  • You perform continuous vibration analysis on equipment with installed Machinery Monitoring Systems (e.g., Bently Nevada System 1).;
  • You set up pre-warnings and alerts to proactively identify potential issues and necessary actions;
  • You collaborate with Operations and Maintenance Personnel, Technical Support Team, and Region Planners to prioritize repairs for identified equipment deficiencies;
  • You assist in troubleshooting by analyzing vibration data and other key machine parameters.
  • You provide vibration and oil analysis history to support root cause analysis efforts.
  • You offer guidance to the Technical Support Team and System Leads on machinery conditions during task risk assessments and gate reviews (e.g., after major repairs or life extension evaluations);
  • You identify and justify the purchase of major predictive equipment spare parts;
  • You provide technical assistance for root cause analysis related to ICSS failures and recommend remedial actions.

    • Education


  • Minimum ISO Cat III certification;
  • High Level of Safety Awareness and good sense of economics;
  • Offshore survival and medical desirable/required.

    • Experience


  • Advanced knowledge in the field of Machinery Condition monitoring;
  • Good knowledge of Bently Nevada System 1 or ADRE;
  • Rotor dynamic knowledge;
  • Oil & Gas Experience - FPSO experience preferred;
  • Able to work autonomously and in multi-disciplinary teams;
  • Must have a proactive approach in combination with a problem solving attitude;
  • Good analytical skills and ability to meet deadlines
  • Effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivated, enthusiastic and able to work as a team member and communicate effectively with onshore and offshore staff at all levels
  • Experience with Rotating machinery;
  • Experience in the condition monitoring;
  • Must be autonomous and with good team spirit;
  • Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken;
  • Ability to manage several activities in parallel, combined with flexibility and strong organization;
  • Ability to travel internationally (short term), including offshore.

    • Functional Competencies


    Mechanical Rotating Equipment - Gas Turbine Mechanical Rotating Equipment - Pumps Mechanical Rotating Equipment - Tribology Integrity and Reliability - Remote Surveillance and Monitoring Learning from events Reliability, operability and safety Troubleshooting Mechanical Rotating Equipment - Vibration Analysis Project control Mechanical Rotating Equipment - Gas Compressor

    GENERAL INFORMATION

    SBM Offshore N.V. is a listed holding company that is headquartered in Amsterdam. It holds direct and indirect interests in other companies that collectively with SBM Offshore N.V. form the SBM Offshore Group ("the Company"). For further information, please visit our website at The companies in which SBM Offshore N.V., directly and indirectly, owns investments are separate entities.

O Técnico de Campo Júnior será responsável por:

  1. Instalação e Configuração:

Realizar a instalação e substituição de partes, peças e módulos em equipamentos de telecomunicações.

Configurar e parametrizar rádios móveis e portáteis nos padrões de comunicação da empresa.

Implementar e configurar equipamentos de Rádio Frequência (RF), incluindo sistemas de Rádio Enlace (Transmissão) e infraestrutura associada.

  1. Manutenção e Suporte:

Garantir o suporte técnico de campo de alta qualidade, interagindo diretamente com o cliente e resolvendo falhas.

Conduzir o tratamento de chamados, realizando a interface técnica e o escalonamento necessário junto ao NOC (Network Operations Center).

  1. Documentação e Qualidade:

Elaborar relatórios técnicos detalhados e precisos dos atendimentos, manutenções e instalações realizadas (incluindo As-Built).

Seguir rigorosamente as normas e procedimentos de segurança (NR-10 e NR-35) e os padrões de qualidade da Empresa's

Basic Requirements


Formação e Certificação:

  • Base: Residir em Uberaba/MG ou região
  • Formação Técnica: Eletrotécnica, Eletrônica, Telecomunicações ou Elétrica.
  • Registro Profissional: Situação regular junto ao CFT (Conselho Federal dos Técnicos Industriais).

Experiência Técnica:

title: Mecânico de Manutenção
description:
Somos a Âmbar, a empresa de geração e comercialização de energia do grupo J&F, o maior grupo privado do Brasil. Nosso amplo portfólio de ativos contribui para a expansão e diversificação da matriz energética do Brasil.

Temos 39 unidades de geração de energia, essenciais para a segurança no abastecimento de eletricidade. Nossas usinas fortalecem a transição energética sustentável para o país e para os nossos clientes. Somos o quarto maior gerador de energia a gás natural do Brasil em capacidade instalada. Possuímos ainda unidades hidrelétricas, solares, a biomassa, a carvão mineral e a biogás.

Respaldados pela solidez do grupo J&F, atuamos na comercialização de energia no Mercado Livre e em projetos de Geração Distribuída para clientes em todo o Brasil. Atuamos na gestão completa das contas, criando soluções personalizadas para consumidores e empresas de todos os portes.

Presente em mais de 190 países e com 70 anos de história, o grupo J&F tem um portfólio amplo de empresas. Entre elas estão a JBS, líder global em alimentos à base de proteína, além da Eldorado Brasil Celulose, J&F Mineração, Flora Higiene e Cosméticos, Picpay, Banco Original e Canal Rural.

Estamos em busca de um Mecânico que irá executar a manutenção mecânica preventiva, preditiva e corretiva em todos os equipamentos da usina, conforme as ordens de serviços de manutenção originadas pelo programa anual de manutenção, bem como as solicitações das ocorrências diárias de manutenção, com o intuito de atingir as metas de disponibilidade dos equipamentos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar as manutenções, preventiva, corretiva e preditiva de guisa segura, em equipamentos mecânicos tais como: turbina a gás e vapor, geradores e sistemas auxiliares, ETA, ETE, planta de desmineralização e de tratamento de óleo, compressores, válvulas, bombas, filtros, trocadores de calor, caldeiras HRSG, utilizando a de referência do plano de manutenção e das ordens de serviços, com o propósito de evitar problemas que causem paralização dos equipamentos e respectivamente da produção;
  • Preditiva, analisar e diagnosticar possíveis problemas em equipamentos, através de relatórios conclusivos, obtendo o diagnóstico em questão, a fim da tomada de decisão para resolução;
  • Analisar e medir as vibrações mecânicas nos equipamentos da usina, identificando folgas, desalinhamento das engrenagens dos mesmos, a fim de realizar reparos necessários;
  • Realizar análise de temperaturas dos equipamentos e identificar possíveis motivos de sobrecarga nos mesmos, a fim de sugerir a intervenção de manutenção devida para solucionar o problema;
  • Executar o plano de lubrificação mensal dos equipamentos, seguindo uma rota sequencial para este trabalho, a fim de evitar paralisações dos equipamentos causando prejuízos;
  • Garantir a qualidade dos serviços de manutenção prestados, através da obediência aos procedimentos da organização, a fim de manter a excelência dos resultados;
  • Auxiliar a melhoria contínua dos sistemas, através da implementação de projetos e modificações de rotinas e equipamentos, a fim de obter uma otimização rumo aos resultados;
  • Garantir a melhoria contínua da gestão de saúde, segurança, meio ambiente e social, seguindo a política de SSMA da empresa, reportando acidentes potenciais (quase acidentes, atos e condições inseguras), participando de reuniões e treinamentos de SSMA e tomando medidas que visem atenuar os riscos à saúde e segurança dos colaboradores e contratados em potencias impactos ambientais.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Médio/Técnico em Manutenção Mecânica ou Eletromecânica;
  • Necessário experiência em manutenção industrial em usinas termelétricas;
  • Desejável conhecimento em Geradores de Energia, Turbina a Gás e Turbina a Vapor;
  • Conhecimento em Pacote office (Word e Excel);
  • NR10 e o SEP (Sistema Elétrico Potencia);
  • Ferramentaria e Equipamentos de Oficina (Torno, Esmeril e Prensa);
  • Conhecimento em Mecânica Industrial;
  • Conhecimento em Caldeira HRSG;

  • Conhecimento de Alinhamento a Laser;
  • Conhecimento em Lubrificação;
  • Conhecimento em Análise de vibração;
  • Capacitação/Habilitação para operação de empilhadeira;
  • Interpretação de Desenho Mecânico.

description:
